question: What is the department name, total number of types of TIP subjects, total number of enrolled students, the minimum and maximum rental new price for each department?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_subject_offered" AS SELECT "offer_dept_code" AS "OFFER_DEPT_CODE", "offer_dept_name" AS "OFFER_DEPT_NAME", "subject_id" AS "SUBJECT_ID", "num_enrolled_students" AS "NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS" FROM beaver."tip_subject_offered";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT "tip_subject_offered_key" AS "TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY", "subject_id" AS "SUBJECT_ID", "term_code" AS "TERM_CODE" FROM beaver."tip_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_material" AS SELECT "tip_material_key" AS "TIP_MATERIAL_KEY", "isbn" AS "ISBN", "rental_new_price" AS "RENTAL_NEW_PRICE" FROM beaver."tip_material";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_offered_summary" AS SELECT "subject_offered_summary_key" AS "SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY", "subject_id" AS "SUBJECT_ID", "offer_dept_code" AS "OFFER_DEPT_CODE", "offer_dept_name" AS "OFFER_DEPT_NAME", "subject_enrollment_number" AS "SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER" FROM beaver."subject_offered_summary";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "drupal_course_catalog" AS SELECT "subject_id" AS "SUBJECT_ID", "department_code" AS "DEPARTMENT_CODE", "department_name" AS "DEPARTMENT_NAME" FROM beaver."drupal_course_catalog";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "sis_department" AS SELECT "department_code" AS "DEPARTMENT_CODE", "department_name" AS "DEPARTMENT_NAME" FROM beaver."sis_department";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tip_subjects AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT td.subject_id
    FROM beaver.tip_detail td
    WHERE td.subject_id IS NOT NULL
),
subject_dept AS (
    SELECT so.subject_id,
           COALESCE(so.offer_dept_code, d.department_code) AS dept_code,
           COALESCE(so.offer_dept_name, d.department_name) AS dept_name
    FROM beaver.subject_offered so
    LEFT JOIN beaver.drupal_course_catalog d
      ON d.subject_id = so.subject_id
    WHERE so.subject_id IS NOT NULL
),
subject_enroll AS (
    SELECT sos.subject_id,
           MAX(sos.subject_enrollment_number) AS enroll
    FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary sos
    GROUP BY sos.subject_id
),
subject_enroll_fallback AS (
    SELECT tso.subject_id,
           MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tso.num_enrolled_students), ''), NULL))::DOUBLE AS enroll
    FROM beaver.tip_subject_offered tso
    GROUP BY tso.subject_id
),
subject_price AS (
    -- We do not have a direct link from subject to material; use any material observed under TIP and take per-subject median price via any linked isbn if available; lacking direct link, we will treat prices aggregated at subject level by presence only, using NULLs if none.
    SELECT td.subject_id,
           AVG(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS avg_rental_new_price,
           MIN(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS min_rental_new_price,
           MAX(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS max_rental_new_price
    FROM beaver.tip_detail td
    LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_material tm
      ON td.isbn = tm.isbn
    GROUP BY td.subject_id
),
per_subject AS (
    SELECT ts.subject_id,
           sd.dept_code,
           sd.dept_name,
           COALESCE(se.enroll, sef.enroll, 0) AS enroll,
           sp.min_rental_new_price,
           sp.max_rental_new_price
    FROM tip_subjects ts
    LEFT JOIN subject_dept sd ON sd.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_enroll se ON se.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_enroll_fallback sef ON sef.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_price sp ON sp.subject_id = ts.subject_id
)
SELECT 
    sd_final.dept_name AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subject_id) AS total_types_of_tip_subjects,
    CAST(SUM(ps.enroll) AS BIGINT) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(ps.min_rental_new_price) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(ps.max_rental_new_price) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM per_subject ps
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT dept_code, dept_name FROM subject_dept
) sd_final
ON sd_final.dept_code = ps.dept_code
GROUP BY sd_final.dept_name
ORDER BY sd_final.dept_name NULLS LAST

# Compute per-department aggregates for TIP subjects based on retrieved beaver tables.
# Assumptions:
# - TIP subjects are those appearing in beaver.tip_detail.subject_id.
# - Enrollment prefers beaver.subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER; fallback uses beaver.tip_subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.
# - Prices come from beaver.tip_material joined via ISBN from beaver.tip_detail; 0 treated as NULL.

query = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tip_subjects AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT td.subject_id
    FROM beaver.tip_detail td
    WHERE td.subject_id IS NOT NULL
),
subject_dept AS (
    SELECT so.subject_id,
           so.offer_dept_code AS dept_code,
           so.offer_dept_name AS dept_name
    FROM beaver.subject_offered so
    WHERE so.subject_id IS NOT NULL
),
subject_enroll AS (
    SELECT sos.subject_id,
           MAX(sos.subject_enrollment_number) AS enroll
    FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary sos
    GROUP BY sos.subject_id
),
subject_enroll_fallback AS (
    SELECT tso.subject_id,
           MAX(tso.num_enrolled_students) AS enroll
    FROM beaver.tip_subject_offered tso
    GROUP BY tso.subject_id
),
subject_price AS (
    SELECT td.subject_id,
           AVG(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS avg_rental_new_price,
           MIN(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS min_rental_new_price,
           MAX(NULLIF(tm.rental_new_price, 0)) AS max_rental_new_price
    FROM beaver.tip_detail td
    LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_material tm
      ON td.isbn = tm.isbn
    GROUP BY td.subject_id
),
per_subject AS (
    SELECT ts.subject_id,
           sd.dept_code,
           sd.dept_name,
           COALESCE(se.enroll, sef.enroll, 0) AS enroll,
           sp.min_rental_new_price,
           sp.max_rental_new_price
    FROM tip_subjects ts
    LEFT JOIN subject_dept sd ON sd.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_enroll se ON se.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_enroll_fallback sef ON sef.subject_id = ts.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_price sp ON sp.subject_id = ts.subject_id
)
SELECT 
    sd_final.dept_name AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subject_id) AS total_types_of_tip_subjects,
    CAST(SUM(ps.enroll) AS BIGINT) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(ps.min_rental_new_price) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(ps.max_rental_new_price) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM per_subject ps
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT dept_code, dept_name FROM subject_dept

ON sd_final.dept_code = ps.dept_code
GROUP BY sd_final.dept_name
ORDER BY sd_final.dept_name NULLS LAST
""")
